## tal-a21-p01–p07 — ahnika 21
**SUMMARY.** [and]-:C21 atha śrītantrāloke ekaviṃśatitamamāhnikam parokṣasaṃsthitasyātha dīkṣākarma nigadyate bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ nīyate sadguruṃ prati / ityasminmālinīvākye pratiḥ sāṃmukhyāvācakaḥ sāṃmukhyaṃ cāsya śiṣyasya tatkṛpāspadatātmakam / tamārādhyeti vacanaṃ kṛpāhetūpalakṣaṇam tatsaṃbandhāttataḥ kaścittatkṣaṇādapavṛjyate / ityasyāyamapi hyartho mālinīvākyasanmaṇeḥ tatkṣaṇāditi nāsyāsti yiyāsādikṣaṇāntaram / kiṃtvevameva karuṇānighnastaṃ gururuddharet gurusevākṣīṇatanordīkṣāmaprāpya pañcatām / gatasyātha svayaṃ mṛtyukṣaṇoditatathāruceḥ athavādharatantrādidīkṣāsaṃskārabhāginaḥ / prāptasāmayikasyātha parāṃ dīkṣāmavindataḥ ḍimbāhatasya yogeśībhakṣitasyābhicārataḥ / mṛtasya guruṇā yantratantrādinihatasya vā bhraṣṭasvasamayasyātha dīkṣāṃ prāptavato@pyalam / bandhubhāryāsuhṛtputragāḍhābhyarthanayogataḥ svayaṃ tadviṣayotpannakaruṇābalato@pi vā / vijñātatanmukhāyātaśaktipātāṃśadharmaṇaḥ [and]-gururdīkṣāṃ mṛtoddhārīṃ kurvīta śivadāyinīm / śrīmṛtyuñjayasiddhādau taduktaṃ parameśinā adīkṣite nṛpatyādāvalase patite mṛte / bālāturastrīvṛddhe ca mṛtoddhāraṃ prakalpayet vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ sa tu saṃkṣipta iṣyate / gurvādipūjārahito bāhye bhogāya sā yataḥ adhivāsacarukṣetraṃ śayyāmaṇḍalakalpane / nopayogyatra tacchiṣyasaṃskriyāsvapnadṛṣṭaye mantrasaṃnidhisaṃtṛptiyogāyātra tu maṇḍalam / bhūyodine ca devārcā sākṣānnāsyopakāri tat kriyopakaraṇasthānamaṇḍalākṛtimantrataḥ / dhyānayogaikatadbhaktijñānatanmayabhāvataḥ tatpraviṣṭasya kasyāpi śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gurostathā / ekādaśaite kathitāḥ saṃnidhānāya hetavaḥ uttarottaramutkṛṣṭāstathā vyāmiśraṇāvaśāt / kriyātibhūyasī puṣpādyuttamaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ekaliṅgādi ca sthānaṃ yatrātmā saṃprasīdati / maṇḍalaṃ tritriśūlābjacakraṃ yanmantramaṇḍale anāhūte@pi dṛṣṭaṃ satsamayitvaprasādhanam / taduktaṃ mālinītantre siddhaṃ samayamaṇḍalam [and]-yena saṃdṛṣṭamātreti siddhamātrapadadvayāt / ākṛtirdīptarūpā yā mantrastadvatsudīptikaḥ śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭamato neha kathitaṃ vistarātpunaḥ / kṛtvā maṇḍalamabhyarcya tatra devaṃ kuśairatha gomayenākṛtiṃ kuryācchiṣyavattāṃ nidhāpayet / tatastasyāṃ śodhyamekamadhvānaṃ vyāptibhāvanāt prakṛtyantaṃ vinikṣipya punarenaṃ vidhiṃ caret / mahājālaprayogeṇa sarvasmādadhvamadhyataḥ cittamākṛṣya tatrasthaṃ kuryāttadvidhirucyate / mūlādhārādudetya prasṛtasuvitatānantanāḍyadhvadaṇḍaṃ vīryeṇākramya nāsāgaganaparigataṃ vikṣipan vyāptumīṣṭe / yāvaddhūmābhirāmapracitataraśikhājālakenādhvacakraṃ saṃchādyābhīṣṭajīvānayanamiti mahājālanāmā prayogaḥ etenācchādanīyaṃ vrajati paravaśaṃ saṃmukhīnatvamādau pañcādānīyate cetsakalamatha tato@pyadhvamadhyādyatheṣṭam / ākṛṣṭāvuddhṛtau vā mṛtajanaviṣaye karṣaṇīye@tha jīve yogaḥ śrīśaṃbhunāthāgamaparigamito jālanāmā mayoktaḥ ciravighaṭite senāyugmeyathāmilite punarhayagajanaraṃ svāṃ svāṃ jātiṃ rasādabhidhāvati / karaṇapavanairnāḍīcakraistathaiva samāgatairnijanijarasādekībhāvyaṃ svajālavaśīkṛtaiḥ mahājālasamākṛṣṭo jīvo vijñānaśālinā / svaḥpretatiryaṅnirayāṃstadaivaiṣa vimuñcati tajjñānamantrayogāptaḥ puruṣaścaiṣa kṛtrimam / yogīva sādhyahṛdayāttadā tādātmyamujjhati sthāvarādidaśāścitrāstatsalokasamīpatāḥ / tyajecceti na citraṃ sa evaṃ yaḥ karmaṇāpi vā [and]-adhikāriśarīratvānmānuṣye tu śarīragaḥ / na tadā mucyate dehāddehānte tu śivaṃ vrajet tasmindehe tu kāpyasya jāyate śāṅkarī parā / bhaktirūhācca vijñānādācāryādvāpyasevitāt taddehasaṃsthito@pyeṣa jīvo jālabalādimam / dārbhādidehaṃ vyāpnoti svādhiṣṭhityāpyacetayan yogamantrakriyājñānabhūyobalavaśātpunaḥ / manuṣyadehamapyeṣa tadaivāśu vimuñcati suptakalpo@pyadeho@pi yo jīvaḥ so@pi jālataḥ / ākṛṣṭo dārbhamāyāti dehaṃ phalamayaṃ ca vā jātīphalādi yatkiṃcittena vā dehakalpanā / antarbahirdvayaucityāttadatrotkṛṣṭamucyate tato jālakramānītaḥ sa jīvaḥ suptavatsthitaḥ / manoviśiṣṭadehādisāmagrīprāptyabhāvataḥ na spandate na jānāti na vakti na kilecchati / tādṛśasyaiva saṃskārān sarvān prāgvatprakalpayet nirbījadīkṣāyogena sarvaṃ kṛtvā puroditam / vidhiṃ yojanikāṃ pūrṇāhutyā sākaṃ kṣipecca tam dārbhādidehe mantrāgnāvarpite pūrṇayā saha / muktapāśaḥ śivaṃ yāti punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ [and]-sapratyayā tviyaṃ yatra spandate darbhajā tanuḥ / tatra prāṇamanomantrārpaṇayogāttathā bhavet sābhyāsasya tadapyuktaṃ balāśvāsi na tatkṛte / mṛtoddhāroditaireva yathāsaṃbhūti hetubhiḥ jīvatparokṣadīkṣāpi kāryā nirbījikā tu sā / tasyāṃ darbhākṛtiprāyakalpane jālayogataḥ saṃkalpamātreṇākarṣo jīvasya mṛtibhītitaḥ / śiṣṭaṃ prāgvatkuśādyutthākāraviploṣavarjitam pārimityādanaiśvaryātsādhye niyatiyantraṇāt / jālākṛṣṭirvinābhyāsaṃ rāgadveṣānna jāyate parokṣa evātulyābhirdīkṣābhiryadi dīkṣitaḥ / tatrottaraṃ syādbalavatsaṃskārāya tvadhastanam bhuktiyojanikāyāṃ tu bhūyobhirgurubhistathā / kṛtāyāṃ bhogavaicitryaṃ hetuvaicitryayogataḥ parokṣadīkṣaṇe māyottīrṇe bhogāya yojayet / bhogānīpsā durlabhā hi satī vā bhogahānaye uktaṃ hi svānyasaṃvittyoḥ svasaṃvidbalavattarā / bādhakatve bādhikāsau sāmyaudāsīnyayostathā śrīmān dharmaśivo@pyāha pārokṣyāṃ karmapaddhatau / parokṣadīkṣaṇe samyak pūrṇāhutividhau yadi [and]-agniściṭiciṭāśabdaṃ sadhūmaṃ pratimuñcati / dhatte nīlāmbudacchāyāṃ muhurjvalati śāmyati vistaro ghorarūpaśca mahīṃ dhāvati cāpyadhaḥ / dhvāṃkṣādyaśravyaśabdo vā tadā taṃ lakṣayedguruḥ brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaistatsaṅgaiścopapātakaiḥ / tadā tasya na kartavyā dīkṣāsminnakṛte vidhau navātmā phaṭpuṭāntaḥsthaḥ punaḥ pañcaphaḍanvitaḥ / amukasyeti pāpāni dahāmyanu phaḍaṣṭakam iti sāhasriko homaḥ kartavyastilataṇḍulaiḥ / ante pūrṇā ca dātavyā tato@smai dīkṣayā guruḥ parayojanaparyantaṃ kuryāttattvaviśodhanam / pratyakṣe@pi sthitasyāṇoḥ pāpino bhagavanmayīm śaktiṃ prāptavato jyeṣṭhāmevameva vidhiṃ caret / yadi vā daiśikaḥ samyaṅ na dīptastasya tatpurā prāyaścittaistathā dānaiḥ prāṇāyāmaiśca śodhanam / kṛtvā vidhimimāṃ cāpi dīkṣāṃ kuryādaśaṅkitaḥ sarvathā vartamāno@pi tattvavinmocayetpaśūn / icchayaiva śivaḥ sākṣāttasmāttaṃ pūjayetsadā śāṭhyaṃ tatra na kāryaṃ ca tatkṛtvādho vrajecchiśuḥ / na punaḥ kīrtayettasya pāpaṃ kīrtayitā vrajet [and]-nirayaṃ varjayettasmāditi dīkṣottare vidhiḥ / eṣā parokṣadīkṣā dvidhoditā jīvaditarabhedena

source.text: [and]-gururdīkṣāṃ mṛtoddhārīṃ kurvīta śivadāyinīm / śrīmṛtyuñjayasiddhādau taduktaṃ parameśinā adīkṣite nṛpatyādāvalase patite mṛte / bālāturastrīvṛddhe ca mṛtoddhāraṃ prakalpayet vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ sa tu saṃkṣipta iṣyate / gurvādipūjārahito bāhye bhogāya sā yataḥ adhivāsacarukṣetraṃ śayyāmaṇḍalakalpane / nopayogyatra tacchiṣyasaṃskriyāsvapnadṛṣṭaye mantrasaṃnidhisaṃtṛptiyogāyātra tu maṇḍalam / bhūyodine ca devārcā sākṣānnāsyopakāri tat kriyopakaraṇasthānamaṇḍalākṛtimantrataḥ / dhyānayogaikatadbhaktijñānatanmayabhāvataḥ tatpraviṣṭasya kasyāpi śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gurostathā / ekādaśaite kathitāḥ saṃnidhānāya hetavaḥ uttarottaramutkṛṣṭāstathā vyāmiśraṇāvaśāt / kriyātibhūyasī puṣpādyuttamaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ekaliṅgādi ca sthānaṃ yatrātmā saṃprasīdati / maṇḍalaṃ tritriśūlābjacakraṃ yanmantramaṇḍale anāhūte@pi dṛṣṭaṃ satsamayitvaprasādhanam / taduktaṃ mālinītantre siddhaṃ samayamaṇḍalam

source.text: [and]-yena saṃdṛṣṭamātreti siddhamātrapadadvayāt / ākṛtirdīptarūpā yā mantrastadvatsudīptikaḥ śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭamato neha kathitaṃ vistarātpunaḥ / kṛtvā maṇḍalamabhyarcya tatra devaṃ kuśairatha gomayenākṛtiṃ kuryācchiṣyavattāṃ nidhāpayet / tatastasyāṃ śodhyamekamadhvānaṃ vyāptibhāvanāt prakṛtyantaṃ vinikṣipya punarenaṃ vidhiṃ caret / mahājālaprayogeṇa sarvasmādadhvamadhyataḥ cittamākṛṣya tatrasthaṃ kuryāttadvidhirucyate / mūlādhārādudetya prasṛtasuvitatānantanāḍyadhvadaṇḍaṃ vīryeṇākramya nāsāgaganaparigataṃ vikṣipan vyāptumīṣṭe / yāvaddhūmābhirāmapracitataraśikhājālakenādhvacakraṃ saṃchādyābhīṣṭajīvānayanamiti mahājālanāmā prayogaḥ etenācchādanīyaṃ vrajati paravaśaṃ saṃmukhīnatvamādau pañcādānīyate cetsakalamatha tato@pyadhvamadhyādyatheṣṭam / ākṛṣṭāvuddhṛtau vā mṛtajanaviṣaye karṣaṇīye@tha jīve yogaḥ śrīśaṃbhunāthāgamaparigamito jālanāmā mayoktaḥ ciravighaṭite senāyugmeyathāmilite punarhayagajanaraṃ svāṃ svāṃ jātiṃ rasādabhidhāvati / karaṇapavanairnāḍīcakraistathaiva samāgatairnijanijarasādekībhāvyaṃ svajālavaśīkṛtaiḥ mahājālasamākṛṣṭo jīvo vijñānaśālinā / svaḥpretatiryaṅnirayāṃstadaivaiṣa vimuñcati tajjñānamantrayogāptaḥ puruṣaścaiṣa kṛtrimam / yogīva sādhyahṛdayāttadā tādātmyamujjhati sthāvarādidaśāścitrāstatsalokasamīpatāḥ / tyajecceti na citraṃ sa evaṃ yaḥ karmaṇāpi vā

source.text: [and]-adhikāriśarīratvānmānuṣye tu śarīragaḥ / na tadā mucyate dehāddehānte tu śivaṃ vrajet tasmindehe tu kāpyasya jāyate śāṅkarī parā / bhaktirūhācca vijñānādācāryādvāpyasevitāt taddehasaṃsthito@pyeṣa jīvo jālabalādimam / dārbhādidehaṃ vyāpnoti svādhiṣṭhityāpyacetayan yogamantrakriyājñānabhūyobalavaśātpunaḥ / manuṣyadehamapyeṣa tadaivāśu vimuñcati suptakalpo@pyadeho@pi yo jīvaḥ so@pi jālataḥ / ākṛṣṭo dārbhamāyāti dehaṃ phalamayaṃ ca vā jātīphalādi yatkiṃcittena vā dehakalpanā / antarbahirdvayaucityāttadatrotkṛṣṭamucyate tato jālakramānītaḥ sa jīvaḥ suptavatsthitaḥ / manoviśiṣṭadehādisāmagrīprāptyabhāvataḥ na spandate na jānāti na vakti na kilecchati / tādṛśasyaiva saṃskārān sarvān prāgvatprakalpayet nirbījadīkṣāyogena sarvaṃ kṛtvā puroditam / vidhiṃ yojanikāṃ pūrṇāhutyā sākaṃ kṣipecca tam dārbhādidehe mantrāgnāvarpite pūrṇayā saha / muktapāśaḥ śivaṃ yāti punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ

source.text: [and]-sapratyayā tviyaṃ yatra spandate darbhajā tanuḥ / tatra prāṇamanomantrārpaṇayogāttathā bhavet sābhyāsasya tadapyuktaṃ balāśvāsi na tatkṛte / mṛtoddhāroditaireva yathāsaṃbhūti hetubhiḥ jīvatparokṣadīkṣāpi kāryā nirbījikā tu sā / tasyāṃ darbhākṛtiprāyakalpane jālayogataḥ saṃkalpamātreṇākarṣo jīvasya mṛtibhītitaḥ / śiṣṭaṃ prāgvatkuśādyutthākāraviploṣavarjitam pārimityādanaiśvaryātsādhye niyatiyantraṇāt / jālākṛṣṭirvinābhyāsaṃ rāgadveṣānna jāyate parokṣa evātulyābhirdīkṣābhiryadi dīkṣitaḥ / tatrottaraṃ syādbalavatsaṃskārāya tvadhastanam bhuktiyojanikāyāṃ tu bhūyobhirgurubhistathā / kṛtāyāṃ bhogavaicitryaṃ hetuvaicitryayogataḥ parokṣadīkṣaṇe māyottīrṇe bhogāya yojayet / bhogānīpsā durlabhā hi satī vā bhogahānaye uktaṃ hi svānyasaṃvittyoḥ svasaṃvidbalavattarā / bādhakatve bādhikāsau sāmyaudāsīnyayostathā śrīmān dharmaśivo@pyāha pārokṣyāṃ karmapaddhatau / parokṣadīkṣaṇe samyak pūrṇāhutividhau yadi
